title: SU2C historical eligibility set and qualifying result evidence
columns: Qualifying journal report and public date
rows: Metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma; randomized phase III MPACT comparison.

Ibrutinib in metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma; clinical safety and immune-cell modulation.

Mesothelin CAR-T trial across tumor types. The 2026 cohort paper reports 20 low-dose patients: 1 with lung adenocarcinoma, 5 with mesothelioma, and 14 with ovarian cancer; no pancreatic patients are reported. Registry counts are 65 consented, 34 ineligible, 31 eligible, 30 assigned, and primary-outcome denominators of 22; a separate high-dose cohort of three is described.

Review of losartan in tumor therapy; not a clinical outcome report from this trial.

GENERATE trial randomized 601 participants from 424 families; 815 initiated study procedures. The registry target of 1,000 is estimated and must not be substituted for actual enrollment.
Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma phase I personalized cancer vaccine cohort; paper combines results from two phase I trials and focuses on neoantigen-specific T-cell responses.
CXCR4 antagonism with PD-1 inhibition in metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma; trial report describes T-cell recruitment and immunosuppressive macrophages.
notes: Name hit refers to the common core and expanded-query subset. Registry evidence was confirmed for 13 records, journal evidence for 16, and both for nine, giving 20 with either channel. “Not confirmed” refers to this assessment. PMID36593070 was verified to publication year only.
